description: Golden parity for monitoring.getCrossModuleTrend's engagement k-anonymity floor: applyEngagementTrendFloor(labels, rawCounts) in packages/api/src/services/monitoring.service.ts. Asserted IDENTICALLY by the REAL TS export (tests/monitoring/monitoring-fixtures.test.ts) and the C# Tims.Domain.Monitoring.MonitoringKernels.ApplyEngagementTrendFloor (Tims.UnitTests). Pins the ALL-OR-NOTHING guard: if ANY month is sub-floor (1..4) EVERY month is nulled and flagged suppressed, because per-point suppression leaves a monthly-differencing oracle (a caller who knows the window total subtracts the visible months to recover the hidden one — slice 6 round 11). A 0 passes through: an empty bucket identifies nobody, so an EMPTY database returns honest zeroes rather than a privacy tick. The floor is MIN_AGGREGATE_SIZE = 5, so 4 suppresses and 5 does not. A label with no matching count yields null, never undefined.

cases.name: EMPTY database (all zero) -> real zeroes, NOT suppressed
all months >= 5 -> exact values pass through
monthly-differencing oracle: one sub-floor month nulls the WHOLE series
floor boundary: a 4 suppresses the series
floor boundary: a 5 does NOT suppress
a zero is not a free pass: 0s alongside a 1 still suppress everything
a label with no matching count yields null, not undefined
